precondition: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200). Chair, Secretary and Member accounts supplied by QA lead; a meeting the Chair chairs, in the needed status, with the needed roster. A controlled inbox for Guest invitation emails.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes lists the drafts and votes the caller may see.
expected: Drafts appear only for the Chair and Secretary; a Member gets the same 200 without them.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting in InProgress chaired by the Chair, with a Secretary, a Member and one draft vote.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
Sign in as the Member and repeat step 2.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes answers 404 for a caller who may not read the meeting.
expected: Body: { "code": "MSG205", "message": "Không truy cập được biểu quyết của cuộc họp này." }.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting the caller is not a participant of, or a Draft meeting an outsider cannot read.
procedure: Sign in as the outsider (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes without a token answers 401.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
procedure: Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes with no Authorization header.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} returns the detail with options, documents and the tally.
expected: A secret vote returns "voters": null; a public one names each voter and choice.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A closed public vote and a closed secret vote in the same meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{publicVoteId} with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{secretVoteId}.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} answers 404 for an unknown vote or another meeting's vote.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting the Chair may read; a random vote id. A second meeting with its own vote.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{randomId}.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{otherMeetingsVoteId}.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes creates a draft and returns its location.
expected: Body: { "code": "MSG210", "message": "Tạo biểu quyết nháp thành công.", "meetingId", "voteId" }.
GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes lists the new draft for the Chair and Secretary, not for the Member.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting in Approved chaired by the Chair, with a Secretary and a Member.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "title": "Thông qua kế hoạch quý IV", "description": "", "options": ["Thông qua", "Không thông qua"], "isAnonymous": false, "eligibleRoles": ["Chair", "Member"] }

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes rejects a bad configuration with one error per field.
expected: Body: { "code": "MSG209", "message": "Thông tin biểu quyết không hợp lệ. Kiểm tra các trường được đánh dấu.", "errors": { "title": [...], "options": [...], "isAnonymous": [...], "eligibleRoles": [...] } }.
No draft is saved: the list is unchanged.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting in Approved chaired by the Chair.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "title": "", "options": ["Một"], "eligibleRoles": [] } (missing isAnonymous, one option, no roles)

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes refuses a non-JSON body and a body over 64 KiB.
expected: Body over 64 KiB: HTTP 413, body code "MSG87".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting in Approved chaired by the Chair.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes with Content-Type: text/plain and a JSON body.
Send it with Content-Type: application/json and a body larger than 64 KiB.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes refuses a caller who may not manage drafts.
expected: A Member: HTTP 404, body code "MSG205" — the draft box is invisible to them.
An Approved meeting managed by a Chair without the role: HTTP 409, body code "MSG213".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting in Approved with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member.
procedure: Sign in as the Member and send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes with a valid draft body.
Sign in as the Chair and repeat it.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes with openImmediately opens at once and leaves no draft on failure.
expected: No eligible voter: HTTP 409, body code "MSG220", and no draft is left behind.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting in InProgress chaired by the Chair.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes with a valid draft body plus "openImmediately": true and eligibleRoles covering the roster.
Repeat it with "eligibleRoles": ["Guest"] while no Guest may vote.

cases.description: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} replaces the draft configuration.
expected: GET the vote shows the new title, options and roles.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote the Chair manages.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; Content-Type: application/json
Body: the full draft with a new title and new options.

cases.description: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} with openImmediately keeps the old draft when the vote cannot open.
expected: HTTP 409 with the open error (e.g. code "MSG219").
The draft keeps its previous configuration: GET shows the old title and options.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote and a second, already open vote in an InProgress meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{draftId} with a new title plus "openImmediately": true.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{draftId} and check the title.

cases.description: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} answers 404 for a Member.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote in a meeting with a Member.
procedure: Sign in as the Member (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} with a valid draft body.

cases.description: Verify DELETE /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} removes a draft.
expected: The vote is gone from the list.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote the Chair manages.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send DELETE /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.

cases.description: Verify DELETE /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} answers 404 for a Member and 409 for an open vote.
expected: Open vote by the Chair: HTTP 409, body code "MSG213".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote and an open vote in the same meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Member and send DELETE for the draft vote.
Sign in as the Chair and send DELETE for the open vote.

cases.description: Verify attaching meeting documents to a draft links them in one save.
expected: HTTP 200 OK, body code "MSG265" with "documents": the linked meeting documents.
The vote detail shows the documents; the meeting documents stay in the meeting.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote and two meeting documents the Chair may read.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/documents
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "meetingDocumentIds": ["<doc1>", "<doc2>"] }

cases.description: Verify attaching a document that is not in the meeting answers 404.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote; a document id from another meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/documents with Body: { "meetingDocumentIds": ["<foreign doc>"] }.

cases.description: Verify attaching an already linked document answers 409.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote with one linked document.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/documents with the already linked document id.

cases.description: Verify attaching documents to a vote that is no longer a draft answers 409.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote in an InProgress meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{openVoteId}/documents with a meeting document id.

cases.description: Verify attaching from the personal library adds the files to the meeting and links them.
expected: The files become meeting documents and appear on the vote.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote; a PDF in the Chair's personal library.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/documents/from-library
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "documentIds": ["<library doc>"] }

cases.description: Verify attaching from the library with no documents answers 400.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/documents/from-library with Body: { "documentIds": [] }.

cases.description: Verify uploading a file to a draft adds it to the meeting and links it in the same save.
expected: HTTP 200 OK, body code "MSG265" with "documents": the new meeting document.
The file is also in the uploader's personal library.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote; a PDF file under 50 MB on the test machine.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/documents/upload as multipart with the PDF file.

cases.description: Verify uploading a non-PDF/DOCX file answers 400.
expected: Nothing is added to the meeting or the vote.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote; a .txt file on the test machine.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/documents/upload as multipart with the .txt file.

cases.description: Verify uploading more than 10 files or 200 MB answers 400.
expected: Nothing is added to the meeting or the vote.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote; 11 small PDFs on the test machine.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/documents/upload as multipart with the 11 files.

cases.description: Verify detaching a document removes the link but keeps the meeting document.
expected: The vote detail no longer shows the document; GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/documents still lists it.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote with one linked document.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send DELETE /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/documents/{meetingDocumentId} with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.

cases.description: Verify detaching a document that was never linked answers 404.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote; a meeting document that was never linked to it.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send DELETE for that document id.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/open opens the vote and fixes the voter list.
expected: The vote status is Open; the eligible list is the active role holders at this instant (later roster changes change nothing).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote with eligible roles covering the roster, in an InProgress meeting chaired by the Chair.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/open with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.

cases.description: Verify opening a draft answers 409 when the caller is not the current Chair.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote in an InProgress meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/open with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.

cases.description: Verify opening a second vote while one is open answers 409.
expected: The first vote stays open; the draft stays a draft.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote and a draft vote in the same InProgress meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{draftId}/open with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.

cases.description: Verify opening a vote with nobody eligible answers 409 and does not open.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A draft vote whose eligible roles match nobody in the meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/open with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/ballots records one ballot.
expected: The option count grows by one.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote in an InProgress meeting; a Member on the eligible list.
procedure: Sign in as the Member (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/ballots
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "optionId": "<one option id from the vote detail>" }

cases.description: Verify a second ballot from the same voter answers 409 and changes nothing.
expected: The counts stay as after the first ballot.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote in an InProgress meeting; a Member on the eligible list who has already voted.
procedure: Sign in as the Member (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/ballots with Body: { "optionId": "<the other option id>" }.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId} and check the counts.

cases.description: Verify a voter outside the fixed eligible list answers 409.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote whose eligible list has no Member.
procedure: Sign in as the Member (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/ballots with Body: { "optionId": "<option id>" }.

cases.description: Verify voting on a vote that is no longer open answers 409.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A closed vote; a Member who was eligible.
procedure: Sign in as the Member (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/ballots with Body: { "optionId": "<option id>" }.

cases.description: Verify a ballot without an optionId answers 400.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote; a Member on the eligible list.
procedure: Sign in as the Member (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/ballots with Body: {}.

cases.description: Verify a ballot with an optionId from another vote answers 400.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote; a Member on the eligible list; an option id from another vote.
procedure: Sign in as the Member (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/ballots with Body: { "optionId": "<foreign option id>" }.

cases.description: Verify a voter with unread vote documents answers 409 until every document is confirmed read.
expected: HTTP 409, body code "MSG252" with "documents": the unread vote documents.
After confirming each document read (POST .../read-confirmation with lastPageReached true), the ballot returns HTTP 200, code "MSG227".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote with one linked document; a Member on the eligible list who has not confirmed it.
procedure: Sign in as the Member (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/ballots with Body: { "optionId": "<option id>" }.
Confirm the document read, then repeat step 2.

cases.description: Verify a verified Guest votes once by invitation.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote whose eligible roles include Guest; a verified Guest session for the meeting.
procedure: Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/ballots with Authorization: Bearer <Guest access token> and Body: { "optionId": "<option id>" }.
Repeat step 1.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/close closes the vote with its tally.
expected: No further ballot is accepted (HTTP 409, code "MSG225").
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote with ballots, in a meeting the Chair chairs.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/close with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
Sign in as a voter and send a ballot.

cases.description: Verify closing an open vote answers 409 for anyone but the current Chair.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote in an InProgress meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/close with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/conclusion records the conclusion once.
expected: The detail shows the conclusion; recording again answers 409, code "MSG233".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A closed vote with no conclusion, in a meeting the Chair chairs.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/conclusion
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "conclusion": "Passed", "note": "Đa số thông qua." }
Repeat step 2 with "conclusion": "NotPassed".

cases.description: Verify a conclusion outside Passed/NotPassed/Deferred answers 400.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A closed vote with no conclusion.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/conclusion with Body: { "conclusion": "Maybe", "note": "" }.

cases.description: Verify recording a conclusion answers 409 when the vote is not closed.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An open vote in an InProgress meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/conclusion with Body: { "conclusion": "Passed" }.
